scientific_role: small public-data execution smoke for already-frozen structural families; not confirmation
selection_reason: These are exactly the three frozen Cirsium units that were temporally evaluable under the prior strict public GBIF diagnostic. The choice is therefore post-outcome and development-only; no confirmation claim is allowed.

candidate_frames.rule: union of 0.5-to-outer-radius annuli around strict historical anchors, public diagnostic only; no outcome-driven radius modification

structural_methods.family_identity: reuse frozen acsp.structural_graph + acsp.structural_raw_adapters + acsp.structural_support without fitted weights
structural_methods.ranking: full deterministic ranking per method before outcome scoring

prefix_curve.rule: for each frame and method use ceil(fraction * candidate_count), minimum one when frame nonempty; report all prefixes and never choose a favorable prefix as the method

outcome.novel_cluster_rule: complete-link max 0.5 km; exclude recent clusters within 0.5 km of historical clusters
outcome.reason: fine-scale structural smoke only; all radii are reported jointly

public_sources.terrain: GSI DEM-derived public terrain primitives under the existing frozen structural semantics
public_sources.landcover: ESA WorldCover 2021 for families that require it
public_sources.coastline: GSI Fundamental Geospatial Data Basic Items coastline for CIR08

decision_boundary.purpose: technical and biological smoke: determine whether frozen structural rankings can produce recovery distinct from nearest-known/spatial balance in all three source-backed families
decision_boundary.if_promising: freeze a generic structural candidate rule and test on a new disjoint public cohort before any promotion
decision_boundary.if_unpromising: do not retune family formulas or prefixes on these three units; diagnose missing structural information

forbidden: do not select only the best of the three families
do not choose the 2 km or 5 km frame after results
do not choose a favorable prefix after results
do not fit component weights from these opened temporal outcomes
do not use roads/access to create ecological support
do not call this prospective confirmation
